## sminer finding reopen

Undo accept or dismiss

### Synopsis

Return findings to open. For an accepted finding this also forgets the
adoption date; the patch file is left in place.

```
sminer finding reopen <id>... [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  sminer finding reopen F9d8e7f
```

